name: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry
description: Chicken, broccoli and peppers in teriyaki sauce over rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the chicken and stir-fry it in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned
Add the broccoli florets, sliced peppers, ginger and a splash of water and cook for 4 minutes
Pour in the teriyaki, toss for 1 minute until glossy and serve over the rice

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Tender beef strips and broccoli in a garlic soy sauce with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the beef thinly against the grain and sear it in half the oil over very high heat for 2 minutes, then set it aside
Stir-fry the broccoli florets in the remaining oil with a splash of water for 4 minutes
Return the beef with the chopped garlic, ginger and soy sauce, toss for 1 minute and serve over the rice

name: Thai Coconut Chicken Curry
description: Chicken, peppers and green beans in a spicy coconut sauce with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the onion and soften it in the oil for 3 minutes, then fry the curry paste with it for 1 minute
Add the chicken in bite-sized pieces and cook for 3 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk
Add the sliced peppers and halved green beans and simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the beans are tender
Finish with lime juice and serve with the rice

name: Garlic Shrimp Noodles
description: Stir-fried noodles with shrimp, zucchini, carrot and plenty of garlic
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain and rinse briefly
Cut the zucchini and carrots into thin strips and stir-fry them in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes
Add the shrimp and sliced garlic and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the shrimp turn pink
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce, heat through and finish with pepper and lime juice

name: Tofu Coconut Curry
description: Tofu, spinach and peppers in a spiced coconut sauce with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the onion and peppers and cook them in the oil for 4 minutes, then stir in the curry paste for 1 minute
Add the coconut milk and the tofu, cut into cubes, and simmer gently for 8 minutes
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season with salt and lime juice and serve with the rice

name: Pork Fried Rice
description: Fried rice with pork, egg, peas and carrot
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry
Cut the pork into small strips and fry in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes until browned
Add the diced onion and carrots and the peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes
Push everything aside, scramble the egg in the gap, then add the rice and soy sauce and fry for 2 minutes

name: Teriyaki Salmon with Green Beans
description: Oven-glazed salmon with green beans and rice
seasonings: sesame seeds if you have them
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, then drain
Toss the green beans with the oil on a baking tray, put the salmon next to them and brush it with half the teriyaki
Roast for 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily
Brush the salmon with the remaining teriyaki and serve with the beans and rice

name: Chicken Chow Mein
description: Stir-fried noodles with chicken, carrot, peppers and onion
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain and rinse briefly
Slice the chicken thinly and stir-fry it in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes
Add the sliced onion, peppers and carrots and the ginger and cook for 3 minutes
Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss over the heat for 2 minutes

name: Spicy Beef and Green Bean Rice Bowl
description: Chili-garlic beef mince with blistered green beans over rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Fry the green beans, cut into short lengths, in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes until blistered, then set aside
Brown the beef mince in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, ginger and chili flakes
Return the beans, add the soy sauce, toss for 1 minute and serve over the rice

name: Turkey and Zucchini Stir-Fry
description: Lean turkey mince stir-fried with zucchini and carrot, served with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Brown the turkey mince in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up
Add the zucchini in half-moons, the carrots in thin strips, the chopped garlic and the ginger and stir-fry for 4 minutes
Stir in the soy sauce and serve over the rice

name: Vegetable Egg Fried Rice
description: Big bowl of fried rice with three eggs, peas, corn and carrot
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry
Dice the carrots and fry them in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes, then add the peas and corn
Push the vegetables aside, crack in the eggs and scramble until just set
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes

name: Soy-Ginger Fish with Rice
description: Gently steamed white fish with spinach, carrot and a soy-ginger sauce
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Warm the oil in a lidded pan and soften the sliced garlic, ginger and thinly sliced carrots for 2 minutes
Lay the fish on top, add the soy sauce and water, cover and steam over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes
Add the spinach for the last minute and serve everything over the rice with the pan juices

name: Coconut Lentil Dal
description: Creamy spiced lentils with tomato, spinach and coconut, served with rice
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, curry powder and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the rinsed lentils, chopped tomatoes and water and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the lentils are soft
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Stir the coconut milk and spinach into the lentils, cook 2 more minutes, season with salt and serve with the rice

name: Chili con Carne
description: Slow-simmered beef and bean chili with rice
instructions: Soften the diced onion and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the beef mince and brown it for 5 minutes
Stir in the chopped garlic, cumin, paprika and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans and simmer gently for 20 minutes until thick
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and serve with the chili

name: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Tortillas rolled around chicken and peppers, baked in tomato sauce with cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C
Fry the chicken in small pieces with the diced onion and peppers in the oil for 7 minutes, then stir in the cumin, paprika, salt and a third of the tomato sauce
Divide the filling between the tortillas, roll them up and place them seam side down in a small baking dish
Pour over the remaining tomato sauce, scatter with the grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes until bubbling

name: Beef and Bean Burritos
description: Tortillas filled with spiced beef mince, kidney beans, cheese and tomato
instructions: Brown the beef mince with the diced onion in a dry pan over high heat for 6 minutes
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, the drained kidney beans and a splash of water and cook for 3 minutes
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with the beef and beans, grated cheese and diced tomato, fold in the sides and roll up tightly

name: Fish Tacos
description: Pan-fried white fish in tortillas with lettuce, tomato and a lime yogurt sauce
instructions: Season the fish with the paprika, cumin and salt and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, then break into large flakes
Stir lime juice and a pinch of salt into the yogurt
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with shredded lettuce, the fish and diced tomato and drizzle with the yogurt sauce

name: Sweet Potato and Bean Chili
description: Thick vegan chili with sweet potato, kidney beans, peppers and corn
instructions: Soften the diced onion and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the cumin, paprika and chili flakes
Add the sweet potato in 2 cm cubes, the chopped tomatoes and the water and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender
Stir in the drained kidney beans and corn and cook for 5 more minutes
Season with salt

name: Loaded Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: Rice bowl with spiced chicken, beans, corn, tomato and avocado
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Coat the chicken, cut into strips, with the cumin, paprika and salt and fry in the oil for 7 minutes until cooked through
Warm the drained kidney beans and corn in the pan for 1 minute
Serve the rice topped with the chicken, beans, corn, diced tomato and sliced avocado, with lime juice squeezed over

name: Pork Tacos with Corn Salsa
description: Seared pork strips in tortillas with a fresh corn and tomato salsa
instructions: Mix the corn with the diced tomato, finely diced onion, lime juice and a pinch of salt
Cut the pork into thin strips and coat with the cumin, paprika and salt
Fry the pork in the oil over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes until browned and cooked through
Warm the tortillas and fill them with the pork and salsa

name: Shrimp Fajitas
description: Sizzling shrimp with peppers and onion in warm tortillas
instructions: Slice the peppers and onion and fry them in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until soft and charred at the edges
Add the shrimp with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes and salt and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with the shrimp and vegetables and squeeze over lime juice

name: Turkey and Bean Chili
description: Lean turkey mince chili with kidney beans and peppers, served with rice
instructions: Soften the diced onion and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the turkey mince and brown it for 5 minutes
Stir in the cumin, paprika and chili flakes, then the chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans
Simmer for 15 minutes until thick and season with salt
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and serve with the chili

name: Mexican Stuffed Peppers
description: Peppers filled with mince, rice and corn, baked with cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain
Brown the mince in a dry pan for 5 minutes and stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, corn, rice and tomato sauce
Halve the peppers lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Fill the pepper halves with the mixture
Place in a baking dish, cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover, top with the grated cheese and bake 10 more minutes

name: Tofu and Bean Tacos
description: Crumbled spiced tofu and kidney beans in tortillas with tomato and lettuce
instructions: Crumble the tofu into the hot oil and fry over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden
Add the cumin, paprika, chili flakes, salt and drained kidney beans and cook for 2 minutes
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Fill them with the tofu and beans, diced tomato and shredded lettuce and finish with lime juice

name: Chicken Quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas with chicken, peppers and melted cheese, with fresh tomato
instructions: Cut the chicken into small pieces, season with the paprika, cumin and salt and fry in the oil for 6 minutes with the diced peppers
Cover one tortilla with half the grated cheese, the chicken and peppers and the rest of the cheese, then top with the second tortilla
Cook in a clean dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and melted
Cut into wedges and serve with the diced tomato

name: Beef Burrito Salad Bowl
description: Seared beef over lettuce with rice, beans, corn, tomato and avocado
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it cool a little
Rub the beef with the cumin, paprika and salt and sear it in the oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, then rest it for 3 minutes and slice thinly
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato and avocado
Build the bowl with the lettuce, rice, drained kidney beans, corn, tomato and avocado, top with the beef and squeeze over lime juice

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic beef and tomato ragù with spaghetti and parmesan
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 6 minutes
Add the beef mince and brown it well for 6 minutes, then stir in the chopped garlic and oregano
Add the chopped tomatoes, season and simmer gently for 25 minutes, adding a splash of water if it gets too thick
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, drain, toss with the sauce and serve with the grated parmesan

name: Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Pasta
description: Pasta in a garlic cream sauce with chicken, mushrooms and parmesan
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a little of the water
Fry the chicken in strips in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then add the sliced mushrooms for 4 minutes
Add the chopped garlic, then the cream sauce and a splash of pasta water and simmer for 2 minutes
Toss in the pasta and parmesan and season with pepper

name: Pesto Salmon with Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Baked salmon with a pesto crust, boiled potatoes and green beans
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 5
Put the salmon on a lined tray, spread the pesto over the top and bake for 12 minutes
Drain the potatoes and beans and season them
Serve with the salmon and a squeeze of lemon

name: Pork Ragù with Penne
description: Rich pork mince and tomato sauce with penne
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 5 minutes
Add the pork mince and brown it for 6 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, oregano and fennel seeds
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, drain and toss with the ragù

name: Lentil Bolognese
description: Hearty vegan lentil and tomato sauce with pasta
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrots and soften them in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the chopped garlic and oregano
Add the rinsed lentils, chopped tomatoes and water and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water and drain
Season the sauce and serve over the pasta

name: Chicken Parmesan Bake
description: Chicken baked in tomato sauce under mozzarella and parmesan, with pasta
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C, season the chicken and brown it in the olive oil for 2 minutes per side
Put it in a small baking dish, pour over the tomato sauce mixed with the oregano and top with the sliced mozzarella and grated parmesan
Bake for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is golden
Meanwhile cook the pasta in salted boiling water, drain and serve with the chicken and its sauce

name: Shrimp Arrabbiata
description: Spaghetti with shrimp in a spicy garlic tomato sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain
Gently fry the sliced garlic and chili flakes in the olive oil for 1 minute
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes until pink, then toss with the pasta and parsley

name: Chicken and Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy rice with chicken, mushrooms, peas and parmesan
instructions: Melt half the butter in a wide pan and cook the chicken in small pieces with the diced onion and sliced mushrooms for 6 minutes
Add the chopped garlic and rice and stir for 1 minute
Dissolve the stock cube in the hot water and add it a ladle at a time, stirring often, for about 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes, then the remaining butter and the grated parmesan, and season with pepper

name: Eggs in Purgatory
description: Eggs baked in a spicy garlic tomato sauce, with bread for dipping
instructions: Gently fry the sliced garlic and chili flakes in the olive oil for 1 minute
Add the chopped tomatoes, oregano and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thickened
Make {n:eggs} wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set
Scatter with the grated parmesan and serve with the toasted bread

name: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
description: Tender turkey meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, with pasta and parmesan
instructions: Mix the turkey mince with the finely chopped garlic, half the oregano, salt and pepper and roll into {8} small balls
Brown the meatballs in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the diced onion for 2 minutes
Pour in the tomato sauce with the remaining oregano and simmer, covered, for 12 minutes
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, drain and serve with the meatballs, sauce and grated parmesan

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
description: Creamy baked pasta with tuna, corn and peas under a cheese crust
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and cook the pasta in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain
Mix the pasta with the drained tuna, cream sauce, corn and peas and season
Tip into a small baking dish and scatter over the grated cheese
Bake for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling

name: Chickpea and Spinach Pasta
description: Garlicky tomato pasta with chickpeas and wilted spinach
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain
Gently fry the sliced garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes, drained chickpeas and oregano
Simmer for 8 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted
Toss with the pasta and season

name: Greek Chicken Traybake
description: Chicken roasted with potatoes, zucchini, peppers and lemon, finished with feta
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C
Cut the potatoes into small wedges and toss them on a tray with half the olive oil, salt and half the oregano, then roast for 15 minutes
Add the chicken, the zucchini and peppers in chunks, the remaining olive oil and oregano and the lemon cut into wedges
Roast for 20 more minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then crumble over the feta

name: Baked Fish with Tomatoes and Potatoes
description: White fish baked on sliced potatoes with tomato, onion and garlic
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C
Slice the potatoes and onion thinly, toss with the olive oil, sliced garlic, salt and oregano and spread in a baking dish
Bake for 20 minutes until almost tender
Lay the sliced tomato and the fish on top, season and bake for 12 more minutes, then scatter with parsley

name: Beef Kofta with Couscous
description: Spiced beef kofta with couscous, cucumber-tomato salad and yogurt
instructions: Mix the beef mince with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes and salt and shape into {4} short sausages
Fry them in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through
Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Serve the kofta on the couscous with the diced cucumber and tomato and the yogurt

name: Spanish Chickpea and Spinach Stew
description: Garlicky chickpeas and spinach in a smoky tomato sauce, with bread
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then add the sliced garlic, paprika, cumin and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the chopped tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes
Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until it wilts and season with salt
Serve with the bread

name: Lemon Herb Salmon with Couscous
description: Pan-fried salmon with lemon couscous and green beans
instructions: Boil the green beans in salted water for 5 minutes and drain
Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff and stir in half the juice of the lemon
Season the salmon with the oregano, salt and pepper and fry in the olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side
Serve the salmon on the couscous with the beans and the rest of the lemon juice

name: Harissa Chicken with Chickpeas and Couscous
description: Spicy chicken with peppers and chickpeas over couscous
instructions: Coat the chicken, cut into chunks, with the harissa and a pinch of salt
Fry the sliced onion and peppers in the olive oil for 4 minutes, add the chicken and cook for 7 minutes until browned and cooked through
Add the drained chickpeas and warm through for 2 minutes
Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, fluff and serve under the chicken with lemon juice

name: Rice-Stuffed Peppers with Feta
description: Peppers filled with rice, chickpeas and feta, baked in tomato sauce
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain
Soften the diced onion in the olive oil for 4 minutes and mix it with the rice, drained chickpeas, crumbled feta, oregano and half the tomato sauce
Halve the peppers lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Fill the pepper halves with the mixture
Stand them in a baking dish, spoon over the remaining tomato sauce, cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes

name: Pork Souvlaki with Potatoes and Tzatziki
description: Oregano pork with roast potatoes and a cucumber garlic yogurt
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C, cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with half the olive oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes
Cut the pork into chunks and toss with the remaining olive oil, oregano, half the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper
Grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix it with the yogurt, finely grated garlic and a pinch of salt
Fry the pork over high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and serve with the potatoes, tzatziki and remaining lemon

name: Shrimp with Tomato and Feta
description: Shrimp simmered in a garlic tomato sauce with feta, served with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Soften the diced onion in the olive oil for 4 minutes, add the sliced garlic and oregano, then the chopped tomatoes, and simmer for 8 minutes
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes until pink
Crumble in the feta, let it soften for 1 minute and serve with the rice, pepper and parsley

name: Turkey Kofta with Rice and Yogurt
description: Herbed turkey kofta with rice, cucumber, tomato and yogurt
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Mix the turkey mince with the cumin, oregano, salt and pepper and shape into {4} small patties
Fry them in the olive oil over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through
Serve with the rice, diced cucumber and tomato and the yogurt

name: Mujadara
description: Lentils and rice with deeply caramelised onions and a tomato cucumber salad
instructions: Slice the onion thinly and fry it in the olive oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown, then lift half onto a plate
Add the rinsed lentils, cumin and water to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes
Add the rice and salt, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed
Serve topped with the reserved onion, with the diced cucumber and tomato on the side

name: Ratatouille with Baked Eggs
description: Zucchini, peppers and tomato stew with eggs and potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes and drain
Dice the onion, zucchini and peppers and cook them in the olive oil for 8 minutes, then add the sliced garlic and thyme
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes until thick, then season
Make {n:eggs} wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes until set, and serve with the potatoes

name: Tofu Souvlaki Bowl
description: Lemon-oregano tofu over couscous with cucumber, tomato and peppers
instructions: Pour the boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork
Cut the tofu into cubes, toss with the oregano, salt, pepper and half the juice of the lemon and fry in the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden
Dice the cucumber, tomato and peppers
Serve the tofu over the couscous with the raw vegetables and the rest of the lemon juice

name: Beef and Chickpea Tagine
description: Slow-cooked spiced beef with chickpeas and carrots, served with couscous
instructions: Cut the beef into chunks and brown it in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then add the diced onion for 3 minutes
Stir in the cumin, paprika, cinnamon and chili flakes, then the chopped tomatoes, sliced carrots and water
Cover and simmer on low heat for 50 to 60 minutes until the beef is tender, adding the drained chickpeas for the last 10 minutes
Pour {100} ml boiling water over the couscous with a pinch of salt, cover for 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the tagine

name: Salmon Niçoise Salad
description: Warm salmon with potatoes, green beans, egg, tomato and lettuce
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, adding the egg for the last 8 minutes and the green beans for the last 5, then drain
Fry the salmon in a little of the olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side
Whisk the remaining olive oil with the mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomato wedges and quartered egg on a plate, top with the salmon and pour over the dressing

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Pan-roasted chicken with boiled potatoes and green beans
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 5, then drain
Season the chicken with the thyme, salt and pepper and fry it in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes per side
Add the sliced garlic and the juice of the lemon to the pan for the last minute
Serve the chicken with the potatoes and beans and spoon over the pan juices

name: Cottage Pie
description: Beef mince with carrots and peas under a mashed potato top
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter and milk
Brown the beef mince with the diced onion and carrots in a dry pan for 8 minutes
Stir in the tomato paste, water and stock cube and simmer for 10 minutes, then add the peas
Tip into a small baking dish, spread the mash on top and bake for 20 minutes until golden

name: Salmon with Mash and Peas
description: Pan-fried salmon with buttery mashed potatoes and peas
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2, then drain
Lift out the peas and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk
Season the salmon and fry it in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side
Serve with the mash, peas and the lemon cut into wedges

name: Chicken and Spinach Curry
description: Tomato-based chicken curry with spinach and yogurt, served with rice
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, ginger, curry powder and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the chicken in chunks and cook for 3 minutes, then the chopped tomatoes, and simmer for 15 minutes
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted, take it off the heat, stir in the yogurt and serve with the rice

name: Pork in Mustard Cream Sauce with Mash
description: Pork medallions in a creamy mustard sauce with mash and green beans
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 5, then drain
Lift out the beans and mash the potatoes with the butter
Slice the pork into medallions, season and fry in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side
Stir the cream sauce and mustard into the pan, simmer for 2 minutes and serve over the pork with the mash and beans

name: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: Tender beef with potatoes, carrots and peas in a rich gravy
instructions: Cut the beef into chunks, toss it in the flour and brown it in the oil in a pan for 4 minutes
Put it in the slow cooker with the potatoes and carrots in chunks, the diced onion, tomato paste, water, stock cube and thyme
Cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 7 to 8 hours until the beef falls apart
Stir in the peas for the last 10 minutes and season

name: Oven Fish and Chips
description: Crisp-coated white fish with oven chips and peas
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C, cut the potatoes into chips, toss with two thirds of the oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes, turning once
Season the fish and coat it in the flour mixed with the paprika, then the beaten egg, then the flour again
Fry it in the remaining oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden
Boil the peas for 2 minutes and serve everything with the lemon cut into wedges

name: Turkey Steaks with Sweet Potato Mash
description: Pan-fried turkey with sweet potato mash and broccoli
instructions: Peel the sweet potato, cut it into chunks and boil for 12 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the last 4, then drain
Lift out the broccoli and mash the sweet potato with the butter and a pinch of salt
Season the turkey with the paprika, salt and pepper and fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side
Serve the turkey with the mash and broccoli

name: Chicken Meatballs in Mushroom Sauce
description: Chicken mince meatballs in a creamy mushroom sauce with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Season the chicken mince, roll it into {8} small balls and brown them in the oil for 6 minutes
Add the diced onion and sliced mushrooms with the thyme and cook for 5 minutes
Pour in the cream sauce with a splash of water, simmer for 4 minutes and serve over the rice

name: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Mash
description: Mixed mince meatballs braised in tomato sauce, with mashed potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, drain and mash with the butter and milk
Mix the mixed mince with the finely diced onion, paprika, salt and pepper and roll into {8} balls
Brown them in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes, turning
Add the tomato sauce, cover and simmer for 10 minutes, then serve with the mash

name: Pork and Potato Skillet
description: Pork mince fried with potatoes, peppers and onion
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and fry them in the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes until golden
Push them aside and brown the pork mince for 6 minutes
Add the diced peppers and onion with the paprika and cook for 5 minutes
Season and scatter with parsley

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
description: Lentils, carrots and peas in gravy under olive oil mash
instructions: Soften the diced onion and carrots in a third of the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the rinsed lentils, tomato paste, thyme, water and stock cube
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick, then stir in the peas
Meanwhile boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, drain and mash with the remaining olive oil and salt
Heat the oven to 200°C, tip the lentils into a baking dish, cover with the mash and bake for 20 minutes

name: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
description: Mild coconut curry with chickpeas, sweet potato and spinach, with rice
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, curry powder and chili flakes
Add the sweet potato in 2 cm cubes, the coconut milk and the water and simmer for 15 minutes until tender
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Add the drained chickpeas and spinach to the curry, cook 3 more minutes, season and serve with the rice

name: Potato, Pepper and Egg Hash
description: Crisp potatoes with peppers and onion, topped with three fried eggs
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and fry them in two thirds of the oil over medium heat for 12 minutes until golden
Add the diced peppers and onion with the paprika and cook for 5 minutes
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a second pan for 2 to 3 minutes
Season the hash and serve it with the eggs on top

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Rice
description: Shrimp in garlic butter with rice and peas
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the peas for the last 2, then drain
Melt the butter in a pan and gently cook the sliced garlic for 1 minute
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink
Squeeze in the juice of the lemon, season and serve over the rice and peas with parsley

name: Tuna Fishcakes with Salad
description: Crisp tuna and potato cakes with lettuce and tomato
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, drain well and mash
Mix the mash with the drained tuna, the egg, parsley, salt and pepper and shape into {4} cakes, then dust them with the flour
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side until crisp and golden
Serve with the lettuce, sliced tomato and the lemon cut into wedges

name: Salmon, Sweet Potato and Broccoli Traybake
description: One-tray roast of salmon, sweet potato and broccoli with lemon
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C
Cut the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes, toss on a tray with half the olive oil, the paprika and salt and roast for 15 minutes
Add the broccoli florets tossed in the remaining olive oil and the salmon, seasoned, and roast for 12 more minutes
Squeeze over the juice of the lemon

name: Steak with Garlic Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Seared beef steak with garlic butter potatoes and green beans
instructions: Boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 5, then drain
Toss the potatoes in the butter with the chopped garlic over low heat for 2 minutes
Season the beef generously and sear it in the oil over very high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side
Rest the steak for 3 minutes and serve with the potatoes and beans

name: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bake
description: Chicken, broccoli and rice baked in a cream sauce under cheese
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the rice in salted water for 8 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the last 2, then drain
Cut the chicken into small pieces and fry it with the diced onion in a non-stick pan for 5 minutes
Mix everything with the cream sauce, nutmeg, salt and pepper in a small baking dish
Scatter over the grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes until golden

name: Crispy Tofu with Sweet Potato and Green Beans
description: Pan-crisped tofu with roasted sweet potato and green beans
instructions: Heat the oven to 210°C, cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with half the oil, the paprika and salt and roast for 25 minutes
Add the green beans to the tray for the last 10 minutes
Pat the tofu dry, cut into slabs, season and fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes per side until crisp
Serve together with a squeeze of lemon

name: Smoky Bean and Potato Stew
description: Kidney beans, potatoes and carrots in a smoky tomato broth
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the olive oil for 4 minutes, then stir in the paprika
Add the potatoes and carrots in chunks, the chopped tomatoes, water and stock cube and simmer for 20 minutes until tender
Stir in the drained kidney beans and cook 5 more minutes
Season with salt and pepper

name: Turkey Burgers with Sweet Potato Wedges
description: Lean turkey burger with lettuce and tomato and roasted sweet potato
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C, cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss with most of the oil, the paprika and salt and roast for 25 minutes
Season the turkey mince, shape it into a patty and fry in the remaining oil for 5 minutes per side until cooked through
Toast the bread and spread with mustard
Add the lettuce, burger and sliced tomato and serve with the wedges

name: Fish Pie
description: White fish and peas in a cream sauce under cheesy mash
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and boil the potatoes, cut into chunks, for 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter
Cut the fish into chunks and mix it in a small baking dish with the peas, cream sauce, nutmeg, salt and pepper
Spread the mash over the top and scatter with the grated cheese
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges

name: Honey Mustard Pork with Rice and Broccoli
description: Pork strips in a honey mustard glaze with rice and broccoli
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3, then drain
Cut the pork into strips, season and fry in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned
Stir in the honey and mustard with a splash of water and bubble for 1 minute
Serve the pork and its glaze over the rice and broccoli

name: Chicken Caesar-Style Salad
description: Chicken over crisp lettuce with croutons, parmesan and a lemon yogurt dressing
seasonings: 1 small grated garlic clove if you like
instructions: Cut the bread into cubes and fry them in half the olive oil for 3 minutes until crisp, then set aside
Season the chicken and fry it in the remaining olive oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then slice
Mix the yogurt with the mustard, the juice of the lemon, half the grated parmesan, salt and pepper
Toss the torn lettuce in the dressing and top with the chicken, croutons and remaining parmesan

name: Thai Beef Noodle Salad
description: Seared beef with cold noodles, cucumber, carrot and a chili-lime dressing
seasonings: handful of fresh mint or coriander
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the packet, drain and rinse under cold water
Sear the beef in the oil over very high heat for 2 minutes per side, rest it for 3 minutes and slice thinly
Mix the soy sauce with the lime juice and chili flakes
Toss the noodles with the cucumber and carrots cut into thin strips, the shredded lettuce and the dressing, and top with the beef and herbs

name: Chickpea, Avocado and Quinoa Salad
description: Big salad of quinoa, chickpeas, avocado, tomato and cucumber
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes, then drain and cool slightly
Dice the avocado, tomato and cucumber
Toss the quinoa with the drained chickpeas, the vegetables, olive oil, the juice of the lemon, salt, pepper and parsley

name: Chicken Alfredo
description: Pasta in a parmesan cream sauce with chicken and broccoli
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet, adding the broccoli florets for the last 3 minutes, then drain and keep a little of the water
Slice the chicken, season and fry it in the butter over medium-high heat for 6 minutes
Add the cream sauce, nutmeg and a splash of pasta water and simmer for 2 minutes
Toss in the pasta, broccoli and grated parmesan and season with pepper

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Beef strips and mushrooms in a creamy sauce over rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Slice the beef into thin strips, season and sear it in half the butter over very high heat for 2 minutes, then set aside
Cook the sliced onion and mushrooms in the remaining butter for 6 minutes, then stir in the paprika and mustard
Add the cream sauce, simmer for 2 minutes, return the beef to warm through and serve over the rice

name: Creamy Salmon and Spinach Pasta
description: Pasta with flaked salmon and spinach in a garlic cream sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a little of the water
Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then break it into flakes
Add the sliced garlic for 30 seconds, then the cream sauce, spinach and a splash of pasta water
Toss in the pasta and finish with pepper and lemon juice

name: Peanut Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Crisp tofu with broccoli and peppers in a peanut soy sauce over rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden
Add the broccoli florets, sliced peppers and ginger with a splash of water and stir-fry for 4 minutes
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, hot water and lime juice, pour it in, toss for 1 minute and serve over the rice

name: Lentil and Chickpea Curry
description: Thick coconut curry of lentils, chickpeas and spinach with rice
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil for 4 minutes, then stir in the curry powder and chili flakes
Add the rinsed lentils and the water and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft
Meanwhile boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Stir the drained chickpeas, coconut milk and spinach into the lentils, cook 5 more minutes, season with salt and serve with the rice

name: Loaded Bean and Rice Burritos
description: Two burritos packed with spiced kidney beans, rice and corn
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Warm the drained kidney beans in the oil with the cumin, paprika and salt for 3 minutes, crushing about half of them
Stir in the rice, corn and lime juice
Warm the tortillas, divide the filling between them, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Spaghetti with crisp bacon in a silky egg and parmesan sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the packet and drain, keeping a cup of the water
Fry the chopped bacon in a dry pan for 5 minutes until crisp, then take the pan off the heat
Beat the eggs with the grated parmesan and pepper
Toss the hot pasta in the pan with the bacon, then stir in the egg mixture and a splash of pasta water off the heat until creamy

name: Butter Chicken with Rice
description: Chicken in a mildly spicy, creamy tomato sauce with rice
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Soften the diced onion in the butter for 4 minutes, then add the chopped garlic, ginger, curry powder and chili flakes for 1 minute
Add the chicken in chunks and cook for 4 minutes, then the tomato sauce, and simmer for 12 minutes
Stir in the cream sauce, simmer 2 more minutes, season with salt and serve with the rice

name: Loaded Beef Burrito Bowl
description: Rice bowl with spiced beef mince, beans, corn and cheese
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes and drain
Brown the beef mince in a dry pan over high heat for 6 minutes, then add the cumin, paprika and salt
Stir in the drained kidney beans and corn and heat through
Serve over the rice with the grated cheese, diced tomato and lime juice

name: Shrimp and Egg Fried Rice
description: Big bowl of fried rice with shrimp, egg and peas
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, drain and let it steam dry
Stir-fry the shrimp in the oil over high heat for 2 minutes with the ginger, then add the peas
Push everything aside, crack in the eggs and scramble until just set
Add the rice and soy sauce, stir-fry for 2 minutes and season with pepper

name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
description: Spiced chicken with rice, chickpeas, garlic yogurt, cucumber and tomato
instructions: Boil the rice in salted water for 10 to 12 minutes, adding the drained chickpeas for the last minute, then drain
Slice the chicken thinly and coat it with the cumin, paprika, chili flakes, coriander and salt
Fry in the olive oil over high heat for 6 to 7 minutes until browned at the edges
Serve over the rice and chickpeas with the diced cucumber and tomato and the yogurt

name: Tofu and Lentil Bolognese
description: Pasta with a rich tomato sauce of lentils and crumbled tofu
instructions: Crush the garlic. Dice the onion and soften it with the garlic in the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat for 4 minutes
Crumble in the tofu and fry for 5 minutes until it starts to colour
Add the rinsed lentils, the chopped tomatoes, the oregano and {350} ml of water, and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick
Meanwhile cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente and drain it
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper and serve it over the pasta

name: Chickpea, Tofu and Spinach Curry
description: Chickpeas and tofu simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with spinach
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil in a deep pan over medium heat for 4 minutes, then stir in the curry powder
Cut the tofu into cubes and add it with the drained chickpeas, the chopped tomatoes and the coconut milk
Simmer for 12 minutes until the sauce has thickened
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season with salt and serve

name: Bean and Tofu Chili
description: A thick chili of kidney beans and crumbled tofu with peppers and corn, over a little rice
instructions: Cook the rice in {60} ml of salted water, covered, for 12 minutes
Dice the onion and the peppers and soften them in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes
Crumble in the tofu, add the cumin, smoked paprika and chili flakes and fry for 4 minutes
Add the drained beans, the corn and the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thick
Season with salt and serve over the rice

name: Crispy Tofu with Quinoa and Greens
description: A big bowl of crisp tofu, quinoa, broccoli and peas with soy sauce
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in {130} ml of water, covered, for 12 minutes, then fluff it with a fork
Pat the tofu very dry and cut it into cubes; cut the broccoli into small florets
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp on all sides
Add the broccoli, the peas and a splash of water, cover and steam for 4 minutes
Pour over the soy sauce, toss and serve on the quinoa

name: Lentil and Tofu Dal
description: Lentils cooked soft with tomato, coconut and spices, with tofu and spinach stirred in
instructions: Dice the onion and soften it in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes, then stir in the curry powder and turmeric
Add the rinsed lentils, the chopped tomatoes, the coconut milk and {400} ml of water and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils fall apart
Cut the tofu into cubes and add it with the spinach; cook for 3 more minutes
Season with salt and serve

name: Garlic Tofu Steaks with Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Thick slices of tofu seared with garlic, with boiled potatoes and green beans
instructions: Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil them in salted water for 15 minutes, adding the trimmed green beans for the last 5 minutes, then drain
Pat the tofu dry and cut it into thick slices; season with salt, black pepper and the smoked paprika
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat and sear the tofu for 4 minutes on each side until deep golden
Add the sliced garlic for the last minute, then serve the tofu with the potatoes and the green beans, spooning the garlic oil over
